data.title: Published<H> + startup receipt confirmation (bn-283p6; supersedes cr-106znn)

data.body: [risk:high] Failed(Unreceipted) still retains unreceipted artifact names. This update clears only the selected records, while ..self.clone keeps records, continuations, and terminals. claims() then returns those bare handles, and resolved_terminal emits campaign identities as committed artifacts. restorable() also accepts Settled and Failed without checking any receipt. The INV-017 census does not inspect CampaignRecord or ResolvedTask, although TaskTable stores ResolvedTask, so this path passes the claimed closed guard. Failure modes: startup can label a task unreceipted yet still claim or emit its artifacts. Edge cases: Settled, SequenceGap, ambiguous failures, and nested handle-bearing records bypass the direct-field census. Rollback: keep INV-017 marked absent, or make the recovery inventory receipt-tied before merge. Monitoring: alert when any startup claim lacks a ledger receipt. Validation: use an empty ledger for Settled and Failed resolutions, require claims and response artifacts to exclude missing receipts, and add a ResolvedTask/nested-record mutant to the census.

data.reason: risk:high: Failed(Unreceipted), Settled, and Failed recovery records can retain and emit bare published-artifact identities outside the INV-017 receipt-tied census.
